content: वृषलः [वृष् कलच्] .²1 A Śudra. .²2 A horse. .²3 Garlic. .²4 A sinner, wicked or irreligious man; वृषो हि भगवान् धर्मस्तस्य यः कुरुते ह्यलम् . वृषलं तं विदुर्देवास्तस्माद्धर्मं न लोपयेत् .. <ls>Ms. 8. 16</ls>; वृषलो गृञ्जने शूद्रे चन्द्रगुप्ते च राजनि . .²5 An outcast. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of Chandragupta (particularly used by Chaṇakya, see {%inter alia%} <ls>Mu.</ls> acts 1 and 3). .²7 A man of one of the three highest classes who has lost his caste by the omission of prescribed duties. .²8 A dancer. .²9 An ox. .{@-लम्@} A long pepper.
